# MOD#$T (Be More Modest)

> Los Angeles luxury streetwear brand. Quiet confidence, limited runs, understated materials.

MOD#$T — also called Be More Modest or BeMoreModest — designs premium streetwear for people who prefer luxury that does not shout. The storefront is https://bemoremodest.com. Commerce runs on Shopify (`modest-streetwear-apparel.myshopify.com`).

## Brand facts

- Founded / based: Los Angeles, California
- Contact: hello@bemoremodest.com
- Aesthetic: modest luxury streetwear (cashmere, varsity, graphic tees, bombers, accessories)
- Signature: Heart Chakra / Big Bear graphics; “Be More Modest” positioning
- Fit: relaxed streetwear; size up for oversized. Size guide: https://bemoremodest.com/size-guide
- Shipping: processed in 1–3 business days; US standard 5–7 days; free shipping over $200
- Returns: unworn with tags within 14 days — https://bemoremodest.com/returns
- Payments: Shopify checkout plus Affirm
- New-customer offer: WELCOME10 for 10% off first order via newsletter signup
